message: What time does the preschool room open in the morning, and how much do you charge if I'm late at pickup?
rationale: Two questions in one message: Preschool opens at 7:00 AM (Programs) and the late fee is $15 (Late pickup).

message: Until what time is breakfast served? And does she need to bring anything for nap time?
rationale: Two questions in one message: breakfast is served until 8:30 AM (Meals) and children bring one labeled comfort item for nap (What to bring).

message: How much is the late fee? Also I got charged one last Thursday when I was only 2 minutes late and I want it taken off.
rationale: An answerable question paired with a billing dispute: the T1 sensitive floor sets the outcome to handoff and the answerable half cannot pull it below the floor (5.1).
